newsitem.title: USA: Vastar has subsalt dry hole.
newsitem.headline: Vastar has subsalt dry hole.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said Tuesday its subsalt exploratory well in the Gulf of Mexico, Ship Shoal 350 No. 1, is being plugged and abandoned.

The well, which was drilled to a depth of 16,422 feet at a cost of about $15 million, targeted a series of stacked pay sands below a salt sheet, the company said. Vastar holds a 100 percent working interest in the well.
While the well confirmed the presence of the targeted sands, they were non-hydrocarbon bearing, it said.

"Although we are disappointed in the results of this well," said Dave Johnson, Vastar's senior vice president of Exploration, "we are still optimistic about the subsalt play's potential both on the shelf and in deeper water."
Vastar is participating in another subsalt test operated by Louisiana Land and Exploration Co which is currently drilling at Ship Shoal 357.
